entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow, you must be really smart to be[n]able to answer a question like that.
entries.uk: Ого, треба бути дуже розумним, щоб[n]відповісти на таке запитання.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You've gone up a rank, haven't you?
entries.uk: Твій ранг зріс, чи не так?

entries.en: I feel like I got a little[n]smarter from being able[n]to answer that question...
entries.uk: Здається, я трохи порозумнішав,[n]бо зміг відповісти[n]на це запитання...

entries.en: I feel like I gained a rank...
Your [stIcon 0][clr 26][stLabel 0][clr 27] has increased.

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Hey, did you get that question?[n]I wasn't even close!
entries.uk: Слухай, а ти знаєш відповідь?[n]У мене й близько не те вийшло!

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Maybe he actually is smart. I'm kind of[n]surprised.
entries.uk: Може, він і справді розумний.[n]Навіть дивно.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Oh shoot, the teacher's glaring at us!
entries.uk: Ой леле, вчитель на нас дивиться!

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: That one was easy, wasn't it?[n]I knew that one.
entries.uk: Це ж було легко, правда?[n]Таке я й так знаю.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Huh? Uh, y-yeah...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Shoot, the teacher's looking at us![n]Turn around!

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Wow, he got it right... Is he really[n]a criminal?
entries.uk: Ого, він відповів правильно...[n]Він справді злочинець?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: He seems like a punk, but maybe he's[n]actually serious about studying?
entries.uk: На вигляд шибеник, а може, він[n]насправді серйозно вчиться?

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: I guess he doesn't study after all.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: We should stay away from him—

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Crap! The teacher's looking at us!

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Whoa, he actually knew that?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Maybe I should ask if I can borrow[n]his notes...

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Did the teacher mean to pick someone[n]else?

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: There are definitely people who would[n]have gotten that right...
entries.uk: Є ж ті, хто точно відповів би[n]правильно...

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: Wow, he was actually listening.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: I'm kind of surprised. He seems like[n]the kind to just be spacing out.
entries.uk: Навіть дивно. З вигляду він із тих,[n]хто просто витає в хмарах.

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: The answer was so obvious...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: I guess he wasn't listening.

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: He always looks sleepy.

entries.speaker: Black-Haired Student
entries.en: I didn't think that was the right answer...
entries.uk: Мені й здалося, що це неправильна[n]відповідь...

entries.speaker: Brown-Haired Student
entries.en: Hey... Isn't it pretty bad that he[n]can't even answer that...?
entries.uk: Слухай... Хіба не жахливо, що він[n]навіть на таке не може відповісти?..
